name: Armando Barajas
office: Mt. San Antonio Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Armando Barajas is a U.S. Army veteran. He has served as board president of the Bassett Unified School District. He works as a school principal. In his 2016 campaign for state Assembly, he cited expanding services for veterans and investing more in early childhood education as key priorities.
